title: Culinary Class Wars: Evaluating LLMs using ASH in Cuisine Transfer Task
reasoning: The paper introduces the ASH benchmark which specifically includes a 'Religious Cuisines' category (including Buddhist, Hindu, Islamic, Jain, Kosher, and Zoroastrian) to evaluate how well LLMs can adapt recipes to meet specific cultural and religious requirements. It assesses 'sensitivity' as a core metric to determine if LLMs can accurately incorporate these religious dietary elements without misrepresentation.
